muc.title: A confusing tax form
muc.text: At tax-filing time, many people look at the personal income tax form and have no idea what the boxes mean.

muc.title: Hide your tax ID
muc.text: Before sending a photo to a chatbot, cover your tax ID, national ID number and name.

muc.title: One concept at a time
muc.text: Ask AI to explain taxable income, family deductions and tax already withheld in plain words.

muc.title: Rules change every year
muc.text: Tax rules can change each year and AI may use old information. For final numbers, ask an accountant.

muc.title: Five questions for your accountant
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to list five questions to ask an accountant about this year's tax return.
